answer: Under descendant-liability chains, each new identity joining the juniper mesh needs one sponsor, and that sponsor pays an insurance premium equal to base times the square of all current descendants in its guarantee tree, so ten sybils under one ridge node cost 100 units while ten separate honest self-sponsored agents each pay only one, a nonlinear cliff.
